scoring_justification: Absorption bands are recomputed from raw excitation list (T1); polarizabilities are compared to paper values with tolerance (T0, acceptable because only final aggregated values are available and recomputing from Cartesian components is not feasible).

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported polarizability values and absorption band reference wavelengths
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table 1 and Section 3.4 of the source paper
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the published numerical values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual reported values that the reproduction must match within tolerance.

outputs.description: Mean dipole polarizability, polarizability anisotropy, and mean second-order hyperpolarizability for MSi12 clusters (M=Sc, Ti, Fe, Cu, Zn) at B3LYP/6-311+G(2d).
TD-DFT electronic excitation list for FeSi12 (B3LYP/6-311+G(2d)) containing the first 30 excitations; from this the checker recomputes the four major absorption bands and their ordering.

output_contract.notes: The agent is required to re-run the complete DFT pipeline (geometry optimizations, finite-field calculations, TD-DFT) and output the above artifacts. Only the B3LYP/6-311+G(2d) level is required for the scored outputs. The scoring uses paper-reported results as hidden reference for polarizabilities, and recomputes absorption bands from the raw excitation list for FeSi12.
